setup.baseline: A saved custom race with a controlled positive leftover balance.

procedure: Set a known leftover balance on step 1.
Select each conversion in turn and record the resulting home-world minerals, mines, factories, defenses or concentration.
Repeat with Low Starting Population, Hyper-Expansion and Advanced Remote Mining to detect interactions.

documented: 10 kT of surface minerals per leftover point, distributed in favor of rarer minerals (documented-only).
One mine per two points, one factory per five, one defense per ten (documented-only).
The poorest home-world mineral concentration improves by 1% per three points (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact rounding at boundaries is unknown.
How the mineral distribution is weighted is unknown.
Whether the 50-point template caption is a hard cap or only a caption is unknown.
